g.text: Best observed cut rank as time becomes available

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #454545

g.text: Curves begin only when every required run has a candidate. Single graphs: run median with observed min–max shading. ER: median of three graphwise run medians;

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #454545

g.text: shading spans those three medians. Baselines use their original solve times. Annealing includes setup and BURY initialization, stops after 10 sweeps or 30 s, and

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #454545

g.text: does not restart. A finished run's incumbent is carried forward without further search. Wall times were measured with two Python workers.
